{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3.9","title":"Empty signer_iid slice passed to sign_frame/verify_frame without documentation","description":"**File:** rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs
**Lines:** 599, 645

**Issue:** Both sign_frame() and verify_frame() calls pass '&[]' for signer_iid with comment '// signer_iid not yet implemented'. This is undocumented in the function signature or error types.

If signer_iid becomes required in the future, all call sites silently pass empty, leading to signature verification failures that would be hard to debug.

**Trigger:** Future protocol change requiring signer_iid.

**Bad behavior:** Silent incompatibility, frames signed without signer_iid rejected by updated verifiers.

**Suggested fix:** Either: (1) make signer_iid a type-safe Option<&[u8; 8]> to make emptiness explicit, (2) add TODO/FIXME tracking issue, or (3) document in code comment what conditions will enable this.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-16T20:20:03.599605Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-16T20:20:03.599605Z","labels":["readability","edge-case","review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3.9","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-08-16T20:20:03.98736Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
